t: Durable 750mm cone featuring 2 silver high intensive reflective strips. Bright fluorescent orange for easy visibility at night, and cloudy or foggy conditions. Ideal for use as traffic cones in car parks, schools, practice driving, and cross roads. Can also be used on construction sites or other public places where needed. Stable, flexible, and odourless. Resistant to UV rays, moisture and oil.
